agents.description: Portable agent role definitions for harnesses that support agent files.

meta-mode-tools.description: Optional Bun orchestration and pull-request watcher tools.

guide.description: The adapted mstack workflow guide and its images.

benny.description: Cursor-specific Benny automation pack; install it in a project repository after review.
benny.reason: Benny depends on Cursor Automations, .cursor/settings.json, Slack, and project-owned configuration.

unsupported.commands: No commands/ tree is shipped. Harness slash commands are vendor-specific and remain out of the portable installer.
unsupported.hooks: No hooks/ tree is shipped. Hooks need project lifecycle and security policy, so mstack does not install them implicitly.
unsupported.settings: No settings/ tree is shipped. Harness settings are user- or project-owned configuration and must be merged explicitly.
unsupported.automations: Benny is retained as the optional Cursor-only automations/benny source; it is not a cross-harness artifact.
